Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 4), the Planner incorrectly stated that Jorge Brum do Canto was born in 1963. This was a hallucination or a misreading of the previous search results, which clearly showed Jorge Brum do Canto was born on February 10, 1910. The Planner confused the film's release year (1963) with the director's birth year. This error led to the incorrect conclusion that Monte Hellman (born 1929) was born earlier than the director of "Retalhos Da Vida De Um Médico," whereas the correct comparison (1910 vs 1929) shows that Jorge Brum do Canto was actually born earlier.
